title: Adding scenarios to courses
intro: Mobbin references for browsing a reusable content library and adding multiple items to a course.

questions.title: Library browse UX: search, filters (tags, competency, duration), preview before adding
Multi-select and batch add vs. one at a time

references.title: Add content modal with search and source filters
references.question: Q1
references.take: A focused Add content modal combines keyword search with source, folder, agent, and date filters while retaining a scannable result list.

references.title: Character library with selected preview and batch Add
references.question: Q1
references.take: A searchable library grid supports category navigation, a visible selected preview pane, and a clear Add action for placing the chosen item.

references.title: Media picker with search, tabs, filters, and multi-selection
references.question: Q1
references.take: Tabs separate upload sources and collections, while search and All/Upscaled/Trending filters narrow a visual library before confirmation.

references.title: Asset library picker with filter and card/table views
references.question: Q1
references.take: An asset-library step exposes Add filter and Cards/Table view choices so users can inspect and select reusable content in context.

references.title: Question bank with category/type filters and per-item setup
references.question: Q1
references.take: A dedicated question bank makes category, type, and keyword filters explicit, with each result exposing a predictable setup action.

references.title: Select items step with filters, select-all, and live preview
references.question: Q2
references.take: A batch selection step pairs row checkboxes and Select all with Filters, a Continue action, and a live device preview of the chosen items.

references.title: Select or upload papers with checked multi-select
references.question: Q2
references.take: A library extraction step keeps multiple rows checked together and confirms the batch with a single forward action.

references.title: Import selected lessons from another course
references.question: Q2
references.take: Teachable exposes Import content from another course, lets the instructor select multiple lessons, then returns them to the curriculum where they can be rearranged.

references.title: Choose and copy a design into a course
references.question: Q2
references.take: Canva’s course flow searches existing designs, offers Copy to course or Move, and then shows the inserted activity in the ordered course list.

references.title: Build a quiz by adding questions within a lesson
references.question: Q2
references.take: Teachable’s quiz builder adds questions inside the lesson and surfaces grading and quiz settings alongside the growing question list.

references.title: Add quiz questions one at a time
references.question: Q2
references.take: Circle starts from an empty quiz and requires the author to configure each question in a modal before adding it to the list.

references.title: Content library filtered by tags and duration
references.question: Q1
references.take: A content library shows tag chips, content-type filtering, and duration on each result, with a multi-choice filter sheet for narrowing the collection.

references.title: Attach multiple library items with one action
references.question: Q2
references.take: A compact attachment picker previews several selected items and changes the primary action to Attach 4 items, making batch size explicit.

references.title: Add multiple saved lessons to a collection
references.question: Q1
references.take: ElevenReader’s empty collection leads to Add content, then a searchable list with item duration/progress and multi-select before Save to collection.
